name: read_skill
description: Activate one skill per turn; never batch read_skill with another call. The skill exposes its declared tools, so do not activate another skill merely to use an already-exposed tool. Optionally page a declared reference after activation; offsets count Unicode characters, not filesystem paths.

name.description: Exact Skill name from list_skills or the available name enum. Without resource, loads the Skill instructions and activates its allowed tools; activation does not expand task or data permissions.

resource.description: Optional declared reference name returned by read_skill.resources, not a filesystem path or URL. Read the Skill instructions first; omit to load the main instructions.

offset.description: Reference text position in Unicode code points (not bytes). Only valid with resource; omit or use 0 initially, then copy page.next_offset.

limit.description: Reference page length in Unicode code points, 1-4096 (default 2048). Only valid with resource; main Skill instructions are loaded without paging.
